title: Feelings Face Song
hook: A face is a clue; the person gets the final word.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: warm 3D feelings storybook, expressive friendly faces and simple social-emotional tools, uncluttered scenes; visual identity: Feelings Face Song

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child interpreting feelings without assuming
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Feelings Face Song an uncertainty-and-expression song: faces/cards suggest possibilities, while words, context, and asking help us understand feelings more accurately.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child learns not to mind-read from a face and gains multiple ways to express care, anger, jealousy, pride, worry, or thanks.
